body:
The common pattern platform preserves the existing floral renderer and adds shared Lua contracts for pattern definitions, generated instances, document views, drawable scenes and build records. The public CLI and both native TeX adapters use the same validators and vector exporters across the implemented providers.

Stages 00–31 passed. Stage 31 acceptance verified all five exact-head native/browser jobs and downloaded artifacts at bd11eefd36d21104ad46cbdde2684401ec6ee9b8. The pinned Lua/Wasm worker covers all 22 families, stored-instance replay, cancellation, stale results, bounded failures, offline execution and an atomic local cache. [Accepted stage 31 CI](https://github.com/UPerna/florilegium/actions/runs/42216668040)

Stage 32 adds the local pattern studio: actual family controls, native planner-preserving recipe edits, explicit structural regeneration, validated instance reuse for crop/paint changes, guide/scaffold/exemplar/text editing, print profiles, vector exports and recoverable saved work. Real Edge tasks and independent PDF/XML inspection cover borders, knot topology, anchored Penrose/Spectre crops, exemplar synthesis, micrography, maze solving and recovery. These local results do not replace native CI acceptance.

An additional status audit found and fixed a misleading Complete label for partial native mosaic packing; the new real browser case fails before the repair and passes after it. A final input/recovery audit also fixed ignored malformed edit containers and stale preview labels after refresh; native canonical recipe identity now handles reordered JSON keys correctly. The stage 32 candidate is b4b6bed11e73298191f844574b41d4bc56935e39, independently fetched and verified: all 871 tree blobs, 26 binary assets, modes/history and 172 issued prior-evidence hashes match. [Current native/browser CI](https://github.com/UPerna/florilegium/actions/runs/42254490411) is running; stage 32 remains in progress until all required jobs and current artifacts pass. Stages 33–39 remain pending. Execution and resume records are in docs/project/STATUS.md and STAGES.json. This PR stays a draft; no merge, release or deployment has occurred.

Stage 00 used the user-approved verified GitHub replacement baseline because the original delivery was lost. It does not claim recovery of the missing original commit.
